query:
SELECT
            EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM bills
                WHERE visit_id = $1 AND status = 'open'
            ) AS "bill_still_open!",
            EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM order_lines AS l
                JOIN order_rounds AS r ON r.id = l.round_id
                WHERE r.visit_id = $1 AND l.status <> 'voided' AND l.bill_id IS NULL
            ) AS "line_unassigned!"
